# Groviadigi

> Groviadigi is a business automation and custom software studio based in Ajmer, Rajasthan, India. It builds custom CRMs, internal tools and dashboards, workflow automations and business websites for small and growing companies in India and abroad. Tagline: "Your Vision. Our Development."

## Services (fixed written quote after the consultancy, before the build)
- Custom CRM: leads, reminders, quotes and payments built around the client's sales steps.
- Custom automation of any manual work: data entry, reports, follow-ups, emails, social posts, lead research. Written in code, no Zapier or Make fees.
- Consultancy: the paid first step of every project, after a free 15-minute call. A study of how the team works and a written plan with costs. The fee depends on the project and is quoted after the free call. It is adjusted in full in the project price if the client goes ahead, and not charged if the study shows no software is needed.
- Custom software and apps: dashboards, portals, in-house software, web and mobile apps.
- Websites: designed, written and built from scratch, ready for Google and AI answers.
- Maintenance: 3 months free with every project, then care plans from ₹5,000 a month.

## Main project: Growth Center (USAIndiaCFO)
- A central growth system with four automations (social media, SEO/AEO/GEO, outbound email, performance marketing) reporting into one dashboard, with data stored on a one-way in-house server and a person approving every action. The firm's sales grew 15%. https://www.groviadigi.in/work/growth-center-usaindiacfo/

## Why Groviadigi
- Honest first call: if a process change fixes the problem, Groviadigi says so instead of selling software.
- Pure-code automation, not Zapier, Make or n8n: apps are connected directly through their official APIs, so there is no monthly platform fee, no task caps, and client data does not pass through a third-party platform.
- Fixed scope and a fixed written quote before the build.
- People stay in charge: automation does the repetitive work; a person approves important decisions.
- The client owns the code (in their own GitHub or Google account) and the data.
- One studio for CRM, automation and website, plus care after launch.

## About
- Groviadigi is a business automation and custom software studio in Ajmer, Rajasthan. About page: https://www.groviadigi.in/about/

## How Groviadigi works
1. Free 15-minute discovery call, then a paid consultancy to map the current process (fee adjusted in the project price; not charged if no software is needed).
2. Written scope, timeline and fixed quote before work starts.
3. Development and testing with real data; nothing goes live without client review.
4. Deployment, handover with training and documentation, 3 months of free maintenance, then an optional monthly care plan.

## Positioning
Groviadigi first asks whether automation is needed at all. The recommendation can be to improve the process, automate key steps, or automate end to end.

## Proof
- Smart Sun Power (rooftop solar installer): custom solar CRM covering leads, site surveys, quotations, installations and payments. Lead conversion rose 28% within three months of go-live.

## Case studies (signed off by each client)
- Solar CRM for Smart Sun Power: +28% lead conversion in 3 months, sales cycle 45 to 28 days. https://www.groviadigi.in/work/solar-crm-smart-sun-power/
- Website rebuild for USAIndiaCFO: custom site, 54 service pages, three practice hubs. https://www.groviadigi.in/work/website-usaindiacfo/
- Growth Center for USAIndiaCFO: SEO, AEO and GEO automation with about 1% human input. https://www.groviadigi.in/work/seo-aeo-geo-automation-usaindiacfo/
- Data Sorter for USAIndiaCFO: one master contact database with duplicate and usage checks. https://www.groviadigi.in/work/data-sorter-usaindiacfo/
- Outbound automation for USAIndiaCFO: lead finding, enrichment and cold email from 20 mailboxes on 10 domains, with outcomes written into the firm’s existing Zoho CRM (Groviadigi built the automation and the integration, not the CRM).
- Social media automation for USAIndiaCFO: creatives, videos and copy in one brand kit, AI-drafted replies, enquiries routed to sales, human approval. https://www.groviadigi.in/work/social-media-automation-usaindiacfo/ https://www.groviadigi.in/work/crm-pipeline-usaindiacfo/
